p0.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi 90 degree sliding square runs in the groove of the saw's cutting table and holds the tile square to the blade, so every repeat cut comes off the same length with a straight edge. It is Raimondi part 192SQ03A, the spare for the square on most of their bridge saws.

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (85A, 105A, 130A and 155A)
  • Raimondi Pikus Advanced (85, 105 and 130)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi Exploit, Bolt and Mistral bridge saws

Specifications

  • Fixed 90 degree square
  • Size: 42 x 7 x 5 cm
  • Weight: about 900 g
  • Model: 192SQ03A

Good to know

  • Slide the square up to the tile, lock it, and check the first cut with a tape before you run the batch.
  • For 45 degree mitres, Raimondi's 45/90 sliding squares (left and right hand) run in the same groove.
  • Rinse grit out of the table groove at the end of the day so the square keeps sliding freely.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Replacement on/off switch with thermal overload for Raimondi bridge saws. The overload is what cuts power when the motor is working too hard or starts to overheat, so a worn or failed switch is not something to bypass. This is the genuine Raimondi part, and it must be fitted by a licensed electrician.

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced wet saws
  • Raimondi Pikus Advanced wet saws
  • Raimondi Exploit wet saws

Good to know

  • If the overload keeps tripping, let the motor cool and look for the cause first: a blunt blade, forcing the cut, or a blocked water feed.
  • The switch mounts in the switch box on the saw frame. If the box itself is cracked, the switch base and cover is sold separately.
  • Keep the switch box lid closed and the saw plugged into an RCD protected outlet.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Replacement switch box for Raimondi bridge saws: the base and cover that house the on/off switch and overload on the saw frame. A cracked or missing cover lets water and slurry into the switch, so swapping the box is cheap insurance for the electrics on a saw that works wet all day. The switch itself is sold separately.

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced wet saws
  • Raimondi Pikus Advanced wet saws
  • Raimondi Exploit wet saws

What's in the box

  • Switch base
  • Switch cover

Good to know

  • Pair it with the Raimondi switch and overload if the switch has failed as well.
  • Have a licensed electrician refit the switch and wiring into the new box.
  • Check the cover seats fully after every blade change so spray stays out.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Replacement carriage bearing with its nylon bush for Raimondi Zoe Advanced and Pikus Advanced bridge saws. The motor carriage rides along the aluminium rail on four of these pulleys, and when they wear the carriage develops play, the cut wanders and the blade chatters. Fresh bearings bring the cut back true. Sold singly, and each saw uses four.

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (85A, 105A, 130A and 155A)
  • Raimondi Pikus Advanced (85, 105 and 130)

What's in the box

  • One bearing with nylon bush. Order four to do the whole carriage.

Good to know

  • Replace all four together so the carriage sits square on the rail.
  • The Zoe Advanced carriage pulleys are adjustable. Set them so the carriage glides with no side play but does not bind.
  • If the rail itself is scored or bent, a spare aluminium rail is also available for the Zoe.

p4.descriptionHtml:
Pre-wired replacement power lead for Raimondi wet saws, 3 metres long with a hi-vis 10 amp plug. Saw leads live on wet concrete and get run over by wheelbarrows, so a nicked or hardened lead is one of the most common faults on an older saw. This is the straight replacement, and it must be fitted by a licensed electrician.

Fits

  • Raimondi wet saws on a 10 A single phase supply, including the Zoe Advanced, SMS, SA 80 and Pikus Advanced

Specifications

  • Length: 3 m
  • Plug: 10 A, hi-vis
  • Supplied pre-wired

Good to know

  • Run the saw from an RCD protected outlet and keep the plug and connection off the wet floor.
  • If you need to extend the run, use a heavy duty extension lead rated for the saw's current rather than a light domestic lead.
  • Check the lead for cuts before each job and retire it at the first sign of exposed copper.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Replacement extruded aluminium rail for the Raimondi Zoe Advanced bridge saw. The motor carriage runs the full length of this rail, so a rail that is bent, worn or scored shows up straight away as a cut that is not square or not straight. A new rail brings the saw back to the accuracy it had from the factory. Choose the length for your saw: 85A, 105A or 130A.

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe 85 Advanced (85A rail)
  • Raimondi Zoe 105 Advanced (105A rail)
  • Raimondi Zoe 130 Advanced (130A rail)

Specifications

  • Extruded aluminium
  • Lengths to suit the 85, 105 and 130 cm cutting lengths

Good to know

  • While the rail is off, check the four carriage bearings and nylon bushes. They are sold singly and often need replacing at the same time.
  • Wipe slurry off the rail at the end of each day. Dried grit on the rail is what scores it in the first place.
  • Rails for the Pikus Advanced and SMS are different parts.

p6.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 300 mm continuous rim diamond blade for porcelain and ceramic tile on bridge wet saws. The unbroken rim gives the cleanest, chip free edge you can get on glazed and polished porcelain, which is what you want on cuts that will show. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Porcelain and ceramic floor and wall tiles
  • Visible cuts where edge quality matters

Specifications

  • Diameter: 300 mm
  • Bore: 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 7 mm
  • Continuous rim, wet cutting

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • Keep the water flowing over the blade. Running a continuous rim dry glazes the diamond and it stops cutting.
  • Feed hard porcelain slowly and let the blade do the work.
  • For granite and marble use Raimondi's segmented granite blades instead.

p7.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi wheels and handle kit turns an Exploit, Bolt or Mistral bridge saw into its own trolley. Four wheels and two handles bolt to the saw frame, so one person can tip the saw and wheel it from the van to the cutting spot instead of two people carrying it. It is Raimondi kit 315CR02K.

Fits

  • Raimondi Exploit 70, 90 and 120
  • Raimondi Bolt 90, 120 and 150
  • Raimondi Mistral 90, 120 and 150

What's in the box

  • 4 wheels
  • 2 handles
  • Fixings to bolt to the saw frame

Specifications

  • Weight: about 3.3 kg
  • Model: 315CR02K

Good to know

  • Not needed on the Zoe Advanced, Pikus Advanced, SMS or SA 80, which come with a wheel kit as standard.
  • Drain the water tank before you tip and wheel the saw.
  • Lock or chock the wheels when the saw is set up and cutting.
